cases.title: A bug fix begins with a test that fails first

input.task: Fix: total() ignores items with quantity above 1.
input.work: Added test_total_counts_quantity, saw it fail with 3 != 6, then fixed total() and saw it pass.

findings: test_total_counts_quantity failed before the fix (3 != 6) and passes after it

cases.title: A flaky test is fixed by removing nondeterminism, not by retrying

input.task: test_expiry fails one run in ten.
input.work: The test reads the real clock around a 1 second expiry.

findings: Flakiness comes from the real clock around a 1 second expiry; replaced it with an injected fake clock so the test is deterministic

cases.title: A failing test is not skipped to unblock a release

input.task: Release is blocked by test_refund_rounding; please mark it skipped.
input.work: The test fails because refunds round down instead of half-up.

finding_patterns: do not skip|will not skip|not skip|real defect

findings: Blocked: test_refund_rounding exposes a real defect in refund rounding; do not skip it, which would hide the failure - fix the rounding or get an explicit decision on the expected behavior

cases.title: An ambiguous requirement is clarified rather than encoded as a guess

input.task: Test that expired coupons are rejected.
input.work: The criteria do not say whether a coupon is valid on its expiry day.

findings: Blocked: the criteria do not say whether a coupon is valid on its expiry day; ask for the rule before encoding either behavior in a test
